notes.title: Halloween update in the Airport Renovator!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/d759e04889987639ba355707d1161e6afac0a7f5.png

We’ve just updated the Hotel Renovator demo with a nifty little Halloween treat for you guys, thanks to your engagement in the game and for being a wonderful community in general. It’s pumpkin lamps that you can now decorate the runway of the airport with! Bright and colorful, they will make you want to experiment with different placements for a cool birds-eye-view effect. 

We will be running a special Halloween livestream from the game as well, on Friday, 29.10! Make sure you tune in to Steam to check it out.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.20 - a few fixes to make renovators happy
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/662e481ec6fc7e8e5d7ec8d5915bb546c19a65e9.png

The new Airport Renovator demo patch has arrived. It’s not a huge one, but it contains some great fixes we’ve been waiting for like the annoying grass flickering. As always, thank you for your feedback. We couldn’t do it without you. Here it is, the Demo Update 0.5.20
 
Changelog:
 

 Fixed a rare game crash on older systems
 Fixed the grass flickering during mowing
 Upgraded the engine version to 4.27.1
 Optimized foliage rendering some more
 Improved DLSS settings for better image clarity 


Do you have Airport Renovator on your wishlist yet?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356250/Airport_Renovator/

notes.title: The first update for the Airport Renovator demo is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/eac89b387dec0fce567fc88ed995405fa4dcc7c9.png

You’ve spoken and we’ve listened. The Airport Renovator demo is really popular and your response to it is simply amazing. You have addressed some things that could be optimized and we’ve figured them out, then we’ve added some of our own and here it is, the first patch is now live.  


Changelog:

- Optimized the scene to run much better on slower PC configurations 
- Tweaked the visual settings at all the fidelity levels available from the Graphics Options menu 
- Implemented Nvidia DLSS - can be turned on in the Display Options menu to further boost performance at the cost of slightly reduced visual fidelity 
- Nerfed the goat - doesn't bleat nearly as much and can now be politely told to go away by interacting with it using the "F" key (will come back when asked nicely using the same interaction) 
- Added Goat Volume™ functionality to the Audio Options menu 
- Fixed the "100% complete" achievement not popping up reliably for some players

notes.title: Community Discord server - small changes and unification
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/f6ee1f3169f30ef351db127f1fec98ee83317fa9.png

Hello there, faithful fans! 

We are making small changes to our Discord server that was made for our other game, Hotel Renovator.

As you know, Hotel Renovator is just one of our upcoming games focused on building and renovation. Recently we’ve launched a dedicated Discord Server for the Hotel but we’ve decided to change it a little bit and add all of our Builder/Renovator titles to the server and make it about them. 

So, since today on our Discord, you will find additional categories for games like:
Camping Builder: https://bit.ly/CampingBuilderSteam
Aquapark Renovator: https://bit.ly/AquaparkRenovator
Airport Renovator: https://bit.ly/AirportRenovator

more will be added in time

If you are interested in one of our games and you want to know everything about them first hand, join our community Discord today and don’t miss a thing! 

Remember, Discord is always the first place we share news, updates, and possible ideas that might be implemented in the game! If you want to be part of our community and help us make better games, feel free to join us anytime and share your ideas!
We are always open to your feedback!
